notes: Change how Ervo looks: tap Ervo's picture at the top (or the menu) and pick from 10 looks, like Gamer, Space, Winter or Business
Weather before you leave (Android): pick when you usually head out, and about 20 minutes before, Ervo sends one heads-up only if there's rain, snow, storms, wind, heat or cold
Calorie questions like "how many calories in a spicy wrap and large fries" get real numbers for each item and a total, instead of your steps
Product picks always show a picture now, even when the store doesn't share one
Share long answers like meal plans straight to Notes, email or messages. Ervo no longer says it saved a file it can't make
Thumbs up or down on Ervo's answers. Tell it "Too long" or "Wrong info" and it learns from that
When Ervo learns something about you, it says so with an Undo button, and you can turn learning off in Psyche
"A few things to know" explains what Ervo can do and that it can make mistakes, and the menu has How Ervo Works
Touch and hold an answer for Share and Why This Answer?, or hold a suggestion to stop seeing it
After an update, Ervo tells you what's new in the chat
Faster answers: Ervo's reply now appears word by word as it's written, so you see it start in a second or two instead of waiting for the whole thing
Everyday questions get a quicker, lighter answer; research, shopping and plans still get the full deep look
